name: What should I prepare before consulting with a contractor for a home addition?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before consulting with a contractor for a home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before consulting with a contractor like Hometelligent Inc. for a home addition, it's beneficial to have a clear idea of your project goals, desired functionality, and approximate budget. Gathering existing architectural plans, property surveys, and any relevant zoning information can also be very helpful. Thinking about your aesthetic preferences and how the new space will integrate with your current home will allow for a more productive initial discussion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before consulting a contractor, clarify your project goals, budget, and desired aesthetics; gather existing plans and property surveys if available.
